items.title: Float system specification sheet
items.label: Spec sheet
items.note: One-page summary of the float: the buoyancy engine, the sensing and power chain, and the descent–hold–ascent sequence, with the 3D CAD model and the system integration diagram. Written for the competition documentation pack.

items.title: Control state machine
items.label: Control diagram
items.note: The firmware laid out as states: initialise, sink, decelerate, hold, float, transmit. Shows which sensor drives each transition — Bar30 depth for the setpoint, the potentiometer for actuator position — and what goes to the OLED and back to the surface.

items.title: PCB schematic — ESP32 carrier board
items.label: Schematic
items.note: The full schematic: 12 V input through the MP1584EN buck converter, TB6612 motor driver for the ballast actuator, I²C to the Bar30 pressure sensor and the OLED, and the limit-switch and rheostat feedback lines back to the ESP32.

items.title: Fabricated board, first article
items.label: Board photograph
items.note: The board as it came back from fabrication, marked up during inspection. Consolidated a loose wiring harness onto one carrier and cut the electronics footprint inside the hull.
